The '''training room''' is one of several kobold skill training workshops. It is used to train the [[cv:Wrestler|wrestler]], [[cv:Swordsman|machetebold]], [[cv:Axeman|chopperbold]], [[cv:Maceman|clubbold]], [[cv:Spearman|spearbold]] and [[cv:Lasher|whipbold]] skills. It uses blocks or training weapons, with a 5% chance of losing the item each time it's used.

== Notes ==
* No labors are associated with this building's reactions. If you want to limit who can use it, appoint a [[shaman]] and set a {{k|P}}rofile on the workshop.
